-- Check how many panels exist and sample data
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_panels FROM panel;

-- Check the relationship between panel and plant - are panels linked to plants?
SELECT p.panemark, p.hubregistry, pl.initdate, COUNT(pr.perfregistry) as perf_count
FROM panel p
LEFT JOIN plant pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
LEFT JOIN performance pr ON p.panemark = pr.solmodref
GROUP BY p.panemark, p.hubregistry, pl.initdate
LIMIT 10;

-- Check the date range of initdate to understand panel age calculation
SELECT MIN(initdate) as min_initdate, MAX(initdate) as max_initdate, 
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(NOW(), MIN(initdate))) as min_age_years,
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(NOW(), MAX(initdate))) as max_age_years
FROM plant;

-- Let's check the performance data to understand what metric we should use
SELECT pr.solmodref, pr.perfmoment, 
       pr.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct' as curreffpct,
       pr.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct' as cumdegpct,
       pr.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'anndegrate' as anndegrate
FROM performance pr
LIMIT 5;

-- Check if each panel has only one performance record or multiple
SELECT solmodref, COUNT(*) as perf_count
FROM performance
GROUP BY solmodref
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
LIMIT 5;

-- Each panel has exactly one performance record. Let's understand the full picture.
-- Panel age = NOW() - plant.initdate (since panel is linked to plant via hubregistry)
-- Performance metric = current efficiency from performance.efficiency_profile

-- Let's see how many panels have performance data
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.solmodref) as panels_with_perf
FROM performance pr;

-- Let's check the age distribution to understand what "age ranges" might mean
SELECT p.panemark, 
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(NOW(), pl.initdate)) as panel_age_years,
       pr.efficiency_profile->'current_efficiency'->>'curreffpct' as curreffpct
FROM panel p
JOIN plant pl ON p.hubregistry = pl.growregistry
JOIN performance pr ON p.panemark = pr.solmodref

LIMIT 15;

ORDER BY panel_age_years;
